text:
Type: embossed ceramic table vase
Use: holding flowers or decor; living room, dining room, bedroom, on a table, shelf or console
Style: mid-century modern, bohemian, glam
Materials: glazed stoneware with embossed relief, metallic gold rim
Colors: cream, warm tan, gold
Shape: rounded cylinder with domed shoulders, raised feather leaf pattern, wide gold collar, medium size
Feel: warm, natural, elegant
Goes with: walnut wood, rattan, cream textiles, brass; mid-century or boho rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Mid-Century Feather Vase, 8.66"H, Neutral and Gold
product.description: The reactive glaze used on this 100% stoneware vase is embossed with feather details that make each item unique. Adding to the elegance of the piece is an electroplated gold finish on the top, which brings together modern and classic styles. Feature this vase alone or with seasonal flowers. 5.59" diameter x 8.66"H 100% stoneware This mid-century vase with a reactive glaze finish has a feather design boasts a gold-finished top. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
